[[Moles Quibus]] is a [[Titan]] [[Mesmer]] [[boss]] in [[Hell's Precipice]]

== Missions ==
* [[Ring of Fire Islands]]
** {{NPC location|Hell's Precipice}}

== Skills ==
16 [[Domination Magic]].
* {{skill icon|Cry of Frustration}}
* {{skill icon|Ether Feast}}
* {{skill icon|Mantra of Flame}}
* {{skill icon|Panic}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Spirit of Failure}}

== Items dropped ==   
* [[Titan Armor]]

== Notes==
* Shares his spawn point with [[Tortitudo Probo]], [[Valetudo Rubor]], [[Maligo Libens]] and [[Scelus Prosum]].
* All five bosses spawn in the four locations shown. The two western locations are really one large area with three bosses. The other two spawn points have a single boss each.
* In the western spawn points, one boss can be seen patrolling while the other two will spawn out of the lava after about 5 minutes.

== Trivia ==
* The name can be loosely translated from Latin as "Who is Annoying" or "Which is troublesome."
